info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens Emails API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor for pagination to get the next page of results.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

params.name: archived
params.description: Whether to return archived email engagements.

items.docs: Returns a page of email engagement records. Use the limit and after parameters to paginate through email engagements. You can also specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

Creates a new email engagement record with the provided properties. Common email engagement properties include hs_email_subject, hs_email_text, hs_email_html, hs_email_status, hs_email_direction (INCOMING or OUTGOING), and hs_timestamp.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The ID of the email engagement to retrieve.

params.name: properties
params.description: A comma-separated list of property names to return.

params.name: archived
params.description: Whether to return archived email engagements.

items.docs: Returns a single email engagement record by its ID. You can specify which properties to return using the properties parameter.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The ID of the email engagement to update.

items.docs: Performs a partial update of an email engagement record. Only the properties included in the request body will be updated.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The ID of the email engagement to archive.

items.docs: Archives (soft deletes) an email engagement record by its ID. Archived email engagements can be restored using the HubSpot UI or API.
Searches for email engagement records using filter groups, sorts, and other query parameters.
